record.recordEnable.note: 录制开关列使用简短标签。

record.recordDurationTip.zh: 操作提示: 单次录制最大时长超过6个小时，所录制文件会变更为TS格式
record.recordDurationTip.en: TIP: If the maximum duration of a single recording exceeds 6 hours, the TS file format will be enforced.
record.recordDurationTip.original: TIP: If the maximum duration of a single recording exceeds 6 hours, the TS file format will be enforced.

record.recordFormatTip.zh: 操作提示: 选择FLV或MKV格式时，强制使用H264编码
record.recordFormatTip.en: Tip: FLV and MKV recordings require H.264 encoding.
record.recordFormatTip.original: TIP: When selecting FLV or MKV format, force the use of H264 encoding.

record.operation.note: 操作列不使用难懂缩写 OP。

record.enable.note: 启用任务，不是打开窗口。

record.tip1.zh: 1.定时录像任务启动后，可以点击录像结束按钮来终止本次定时任务。
record.tip1.en: 1. Click Stop to end a scheduled recording that is in progress.
record.tip1.original: 1.After the scheduled recording task is started, you can click the recording end button to terminate this scheduled task.

record.tip2.zh: 2.定时录像任务启动时，录像已经开始了，这时本次定时任务失效。
record.tip2.en: 2. A scheduled recording is skipped if recording is already in progress at its start time.
record.tip2.original: 2.When the scheduled video recording task is started, the video recording has already started. At this time, the scheduled task is invalid.
record.tip2.note: 明确任务被跳过的条件。

record.tip3.zh: 3.在设置录像相关参数期间，有定时任务启动，这时设置的参数会失效。
record.tip3.en: 3. If a scheduled recording starts while you are changing recording settings, those changes will not take effect.
record.tip3.original: 3.During the setting of recording related parameters, a scheduled task is started, and the set parameters will become invalid.

record.tip4.zh: 4.定时录像持续时间包括暂停时间。
record.tip4.en: 4. Scheduled recording duration includes paused time.
record.tip4.original: 4.Timed video recording duration includes pause time.
record.tip4.note: 保留暂停时间计入时长。

record.oneHour.note: 规范单位且适合短选项。

record.twoHours.note: 规范单位且适合短选项。

record.fourHours.note: 规范单位且适合短选项。

record.sixHours.note: 规范单位且适合短选项。

record.eightHours.note: 规范单位且适合短选项。

record.tenHours.note: 规范单位且适合短选项。

record.twelveHours.note: 规范单位且适合短选项。

record.twentyFourHours.note: 规范单位且适合短选项。

record.classTopicInputError.zh: 定时录制输入包含以下非法字符：
record.classTopicInputError.en: The scheduled recording contains the following invalid characters:
record.classTopicInputError.original: The timed recording input contains the following illegal characters:
record.classTopicInputError.note: 统一定时录制术语，保留冒号拼接。

record.noLessThanTwo.zh: 定时录制任务不能少于2条
record.noLessThanTwo.en: The number of scheduled recording tasks cannot be less than 2.
record.noLessThanTwo.original: The number of scheduled recording tasks cannot be less than 2.

record.noMoreThanEight.zh: 定时录制任务不能多于8条
record.noMoreThanEight.en: No more than 8 scheduled recording tasks.
record.noMoreThanEight.original: No more than 8 scheduled recording tasks.

record.noMoreThanCount.zh: 定时录制任务不能多于21条
record.noMoreThanCount.en: No more than 21 scheduled recording tasks.
record.noMoreThanCount.original: No more than 21 scheduled recording tasks.

record.setAutoRecordStateFail.zh: 开机自动开启录制设置失败
record.setAutoRecordStateFail.en: Failed to set recording on startup.
record.setAutoRecordStateFail.original: Failed to start recording setting automatically after startup.
record.setAutoRecordStateFail.note: 修正失败对象，不误写为启动录制失败。

record.startTimeOrStopTimeNull.zh: 开始时间或结束时间为空
record.startTimeOrStopTimeNull.en: Start time or end time is empty.
record.startTimeOrStopTimeNull.original: Start time or end time is empty.

record.timeError.zh: 时间填写有误，录像时间不得小于10秒，请重新填写时间
record.timeError.en: The time is incorrect. The recording time shall not be less than 10 seconds. Please fill in the time again.
record.timeError.original: The time is incorrect. The recording time shall not be less than 10 seconds. Please fill in the time again.

record.conflict.zh: 行定时任务有冲突，请重新填写时间
record.conflict.en: row timing task conflicts, please fill in the time again.
record.conflict.original: row timing task conflicts, please fill in the time again.
record.conflict.note: 待确认：此词条前面是否拼接行号；需连同行号调整完整的任务冲突提示。

record.lessThanSixtySeconds.zh: 行定时任务时间间隔小于60秒，请重新填写时间
record.lessThanSixtySeconds.en: row scheduled task is less than 60 seconds, please fill in the time again.
record.lessThanSixtySeconds.original: row scheduled task is less than 60 seconds, please fill in the time again.
record.lessThanSixtySeconds.note: 待确认：需核实行号拼接方式及“间隔”对象，不能误译为任务时长小于60秒。

record.nameMoreThanEighteen.zh: 录制名称不能超过18个字符
record.nameMoreThanEighteen.note: 补齐录制名称，保留18字符限制。

record.nameError.zh: 录制名称含有非法字符，请检查后重试
record.nameError.en: The recording name contains illegal characters. Please check and try again.
record.nameError.original: The recording name contains illegal characters. Please check and try again.

record.sameName.zh: 录制名称不能相同，请检查后重试
record.sameName.en: Recording names must be unique. Check the names and try again.
record.sameName.original: The recording name cannot be the same. Please check and try again.

record.fileFragmentTimeMoreThanMax.zh: 录制分段时长不能大于单次录制最大时长
record.fileFragmentTimeMoreThanMax.en: Segment duration cannot exceed the maximum recording duration.
record.fileFragmentTimeMoreThanMax.original: File fragment time no more than max record duration.

record.timerDurationMoreThanMax.zh: 单条定时录制时长不能大于单次录制最大时长
record.timerDurationMoreThanMax.en: The duration of a single scheduled recording cannot be greater than the maximum duration of a single recording.
record.timerDurationMoreThanMax.original: The duration of a single scheduled recording cannot be greater than the maximum duration of a single recording.

record.onlyFilmLive4K.zh: 4K模式下只支持开启电影直播通道，请先关闭其他直播通道
record.onlyFilmLive4K.en: In 4K mode, only PGM streaming is supported. Disable other streaming channels first.
record.onlyFilmLive4K.original: In 4K mode, only the film live streaming channel is supported. Please close other live streaming channels first.
record.onlyFilmLive4K.note: 电影通道指最终节目通道。

record.rtspAudioMixTip.zh: 提示: 若混音通道中的按钮为禁用状态表示未开启该通道的RTSP音频输入。
record.rtspAudioMixTip.en: Tip: A disabled channel button means RTSP audio input is not enabled for that channel.
record.rtspAudioMixTip.original: Tip: If the button in the mixing channel is disabled, it means that the RTSP audio input for that channel is not turned on.
record.rtspAudioMixTip.note: 简化说明，保留禁用原因。

record.rtspOnlyAudioMixTip.zh: 提示: 若混音通道中的按钮为禁用状态表示未开启该通道的数字音频输入。
record.rtspOnlyAudioMixTip.en: Tip: A disabled channel button means digital audio input is not enabled for that channel.
record.rtspOnlyAudioMixTip.original: Tip: If the button in the mixing channel is disabled, it means that the digital audio input for that channel is not turned on.
record.rtspOnlyAudioMixTip.note: 简化说明，保留禁用原因。
